place.source_title: Home in Falcon Heights, Asbury Street (Residential architecture of Falcon Heights, Minnesota 02/03)

brief: Streamline Moderne one-storey house of about 1940: smooth cream stucco walls, a flat roof with a thin coping, a big rounded bay wrapped in a continuous band of windows, a chimney on the roof, and an attached garage wing; lawns and trees along a curving suburban street.

floors: W Wb Wb Wb W D G
facade.notes: a 1940 Streamline Moderne house: smooth stucco, a flat roof edged with red tile coping, a curved bay with a continuous band of windows wrapping it, an attached garage flush with the front; a deep lawn

why.note: the 1930s-40s machine-age house: curves, flat roofs, ribbon windows -- rare in the Midwest
